data.description: Structured notification facts (actor, path, snippet, start/end, …). When present, clients format title/body; API title/body are also formatted at read time.

title.description: Display title (formatted from data when present).

body.description: Display body (formatted from data when present).

publicKey.description: URL-safe base64 VAPID public key for pushManager.subscribe.

scope.description: Manifest id of the installed app that subscribes where each installed app has its own subscription (iOS Home Screen apps), otherwise `/`. The subscription then only receives push that opens inside that app (the longest manifest scope holding `navigate`; for `navigate` `/`, the app of the notification domain); `/` receives everything. Posting the same endpoint from several apps keeps every scope, and `/` replaces them all. Omitted means unknown: a new subscription receives everything until a request names a scope, and a known one keeps its scopes.

PushScope.description: Web manifest id of a WeGotWorkspace app. Notifications map to an app by domain: docs to /docs, calendar to /calendar, tasks to /tasks, notes to /notes, chat and meet to /meet.

scopes.description: App scopes this subscription now receives push for; ["/"] while unknown.
